title: A Few Moments of Cheers' Studio Hurray! Animates Wondering Mate Net Shorts
content: Hurray! , one of the animation studios for A Few Moments of Cheers film, is planning and animating Wondering Mate , an original short anime that will premiere on Meta Taxi's YouTube channel on December 16.
author: ANN

title: Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal Anime Reveals Main Visual and Voice Cast
content: CODE GEASS Star Chaser Aspal new anime revealed the main key visual, along with the main voice cast members. The anime was announced in September, with the release date set for 2027. Kazuya Nomura is directing the project, with Mado Nozaki handling series composition.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Fool Night' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Songs, First Promo
content: The official website of the Fool Night original net anime unveiled additional cast, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and first promotional video on Thursday. The anime adapting Kasumi Yasuda 's sci-fi drama manga will debut worldwide exclusively on Netflix on November 26.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Fool Night Anime's Trailer Reveals Theme Songs, Additional Cast
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks unveiled a new trailer, visual, theme song artists, and additional cast for the television anime of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga on Thursday. The main trailer previews the opening theme song "Shake! spit out" by the band Tempalay : Nowlu performs the ending theme song "Iki" (Breath).
author: ANN

title: Spirit Circle TV Anime Announced for December 2026, Reveals Cast and First Trailer
content: Satoshi Mizukami’s Spirit Circle manga is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with the release date set for December 2026. A teaser visual and first promotional video were revealed alongside the announcement.
author: Anime Corner

title: Senren * Banka Anime Reveals TV Format
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the anime adaptation of Yuzu Soft 's Senren * Banka visual novel opened on Thursday and revealed its television format. The staff also announced that the game has exceeded 1 million copies in worldwide cumulative sales, and presented an illustration by original character…
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Spirit Circle' Gets TV Anime in December 2026
content: Production company Twin Engine opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Satoshi Mizukami 's Spirit Circle manga on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), the ending theme, and first promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Code Geass: Hoshi Oi no Aspal' Announces Main Cast, Additional Staff
content: The official website for the Code Geass: Hoshi Oi no Aspal ( Code Geass: Star Chaser Aspal ) new anime series revealed the main cast, additional staff, and the main visual (pictured) on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027, with advance screenings beginning in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Satoshi Mizukami's Spirit Circle Manga Gets TV Anime in December
content: REMOW announced on Thursday the 18-episode television anime adaptation of Satoshi Mizukami 's Spirit Circle manga , which will air in Japan and also stream globally in December. The announcement also revealed the anime's teaser promotional video, teaser visual, main cast, and staff members.
author: ANN

title: 'Magic Knight Rayearth' Unveils Additional Cast Pair
content: The official website for the new Magic Knight Rayearth ( Mahou Kishi Rayearth ) television anime announced additional cast pair on Thursday. The anime series premiered on October 7 at 11.45 p.m. on TV Asahi's "IMAnimation W" frame.
author: MyAnimeList
